title: STDenTable
html:
定义组：简单类型集合语义。有序参数：B、C、k、eta、iota、tau、s。

精确含义以本页公式体及其全部依赖为准。

规范公式

(@ STDenTable B C k eta iota tau s) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(and
  (@ STSig B C k)
  (and
    (@ STInterp B eta tau)
    (and
      (@ STConstInterp C k tau iota)
      (and
        (forall q
          (implies
            (in q s)
            (exists g
              (exists t
                (exists a
                  (exists e
                    (exists v
                      (and
                        (exists z1189
                          (and
                            (exists z1190
                            (and (exists z1191 (and (@ Pair e v z1191) (@ Pair a z1191 z1190))) (@ Pair t z1190 z1189)))
                            (@ Pair g z1189 q)))
                        (@ STSemInput B C k tau g t a e v)))))))))
        (forall g
          (forall t
            (forall a
              (forall e
                (forall v
                  (implies
                    (@ STSemInput B C k tau g t a e v)
                    (iff
                      (exists z1192
                        (and
                          (exists z1193
                            (and
                            (exists z1194
                            (and (exists z1195 (and (@ Pair e v z1195) (@ Pair a z1195 z1194))) (@ Pair t z1194 z1193)))
                            (@ Pair g z1193 z1192)))
                          (in z1192 s)))
                      (or
                        (exists n (and (@ TVar n t) (@ App e n v)))
                        (or
                          (exists c (and (@ TConst c t) (@ App iota c v)))
                          (or
                            (exists m
                            (exists n
                            (exists b
                            (exists arr
                            (exists f
                            (exists x
                            (and
                            (@ TApp m n t)
                            (and
                            (@ TArr b a arr)
                            (and
                            (exists z1177
                            (and
                            (exists z1178
                            (and
                            (exists z1179
                            (and (exists z1180 (and (@ Pair e f z1180) (@ Pair arr z1180 z1179))) (@ Pair m z1179 z1178)))
                            (@ Pair g z1178 z1177)))
                            (in z1177 s)))
                            (and
                            (exists z1181
                            (and
                            (exists z1182
                            (and
                            (exists z1183
                            (and (exists z1184 (and (@ Pair e x z1184) (@ Pair b z1184 z1183))) (@ Pair n z1183 z1182)))
                            (@ Pair g z1182 z1181)))
                            (in z1181 s)))
                            (@ App f x v)))))))))))
                            (exists b
                            (exists u
                            (exists c
                            (exists h
                            (exists x
                            (exists y
                            (and
                            (@ TLam b u t)
                            (and
                            (@ TArr b c a)
                            (and
                            (@ Cons b g h)
                            (and
                            (@ App tau b x)
                            (and
                            (@ App tau c y)
                            (and
                            (@ Map v x y)
                            (forall d
                            (implies
                            (in d x)
                            (exists ee
                            (exists w
                            (and
                            (@ Cons d e ee)
                            (and
                            (@ App v d w)
                            (exists z1185
                            (and
                            (exists z1186
                            (and
                            (exists z1187
                            (and (exists z1188 (and (@ Pair ee w z1188) (@ Pair c z1188 z1187))) (@ Pair u z1187 z1186)))
                            (@ Pair h z1186 z1185)))
                            (in z1185 s)))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖
